Automated-Blood-Glucose-Monitoring-and-H:
Project Overview

  • The objective was to create a robust web application for users to input and monitor their daily blood glucose levels. The platform serves as a digital health assistant that leverages AI for data interpretation.

Core Functionality

  • Data Acquisition: Users can upload or manually enter glucose readings, which are then processed via an intelligent backend.
  • AI Integration: The system uses advanced AI processing to analyze data trends and provide immediate health metrics.
  • User Features: Includes a comprehensive health history tab and a secure profile management system with password recovery and administrative support.

Technical Architecture

  • Frontend: Developed using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript.
  • IDE: Engineered using the Cursor code editor.
  • Backend: Managed via Node.js/En-8n integration with various workflow automations.
  • Database: Secure, centralized database architecture to store and retrieve health records effectively.

Automated-Webinar-Registration-and-Lead-:
Project Overview

This project involved the development of a fully automated system for webinar registration and lead management. The system streamlines the entire user journey, from initial sign-up via Telegram to post-webinar certificate delivery.

The Problem

Manual registration and certificate issuance processes were inefficient and prone to human error, hindering the scalability of educational webinars.

The Solution

  • Telegram Registration: A custom Telegram bot allows users to register or retrieve existing records.
  • Data Handling: Seamlessly updates databases with user details including specialized skills and contact info.
  • Automation Workflow: Using n8n, the system handles the entire logic flow, from event registration to post-event engagement.
  • Certification: Automated generation and distribution of personalized certificates upon webinar completion.

Technologies Used

  • Automation Platform: n8n
  • Communication: Telegram Bot API
  • Presentation & Documentation: Google Slides, Google Drive
  • Database: Google Sheets
  • Integration: Automated email notifications and data sync

AI-Powered-Chatbot:
Project Overview

This project involved the design, development, and implementation of a sophisticated, 24/7 AI-powered sales assistant chatbot. The primary goal was to create an automated system capable of engaging potential clients, qualifying them based on predefined criteria, and scheduling discovery calls without human intervention, thereby streamlining the sales pipeline.

The Challenge

The client, Basant Accounting, needed a way to handle inbound inquiries around the clock, ensure leads were properly vetted before engaging sales staff, and reduce the manual administrative work of scheduling meetings. The solution had to be intelligent, responsive, and capable of handing over complex conversations to a human expert when necessary.

The Solution: An Integrated AI & Automation Stack

A comprehensive strategy was developed, leveraging a stack of modern tools to deliver a robust and scalable solution. The workflow is orchestrated entirely within n8n.

Core Workflow:

  • Initial Engagement: When a user starts a chat, a webhook in n8n triggers the workflow.

Phase 1: Website Development & AI-Powered Content Creation

  • Core Platform: A professional website was built on WordPress to serve as the central information hub for the summit.
